name: afk-timer
description: Shows how long you have been away from a Claude Code session and warns when its prompt cache has likely expired, so you can /clear instead of paying to re-read a big conversation

cacheTtl.title: Prompt cache lifetime
cacheTtl.description: auto: 1 h when the session runs on a Claude subscription (plan rate limits reported), else 5 min. Pick 1h or 5m to pin it, for example 1h if you set promptCacheTtl to 1h on an API key, or 5m once a subscription draws on usage credits.
